creator: Kenji Koide, AIST
dataset: LiDAR Degeneration Test Dataset (Flatwall experiment), v2
reference_source: reference-source.txt is the unmodified selected original gt/flatwall_02.txt member, copied only after all eight estimates were closed.
derivatives: paired-reference.npz contains interpolated reference poses and exact integer times/indices. Estimates, diagnostics, errors and plots are derived from the original real recording.
exposure: All eight member prefixes were historically exposed; full 01 was previously scored. All eight new 02 estimates closed before full 02 parsing. This remains exploratory, never blind or held out.
